forged.name: crustle-fg
forged.rationale: STATUS-MAX: Festival Grounds[1245] Stadium — 'Each Pokemon that has any Energy attached (both yours and your opponent's) recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.' PASSIVE permanent status-immunity for the energized active Crustle vs cleanse's per-clear card-draw (Switch+Galette). cap4, using 3. DOUBT: the ONLY variant with a clean mechanical-dominance story — exactly the cage-shape that LOST hardest last cycle; trust the sweep pattern, not this p. SYMMETRIC (immunizes opponent too — fine, we're the wall) and BUMPABLE (opponent's Stadium removes it; cleanse's Items can't be) => a different risk profile, NOT a strict upgrade over cleanse. p=0.55.

Fires EXACTLY vs the non-ex attackers that beat us; refuels the heal engine without spending a supporter. cap4, using 3. DOUBT: competes with Hero's Cape for the active tool slot (1 Cape vs 3 Helmets, minor); flat if the residual loss is single-burst not exhaustion. p=0.42.
